Revision for CCEA GCSE and GCE Digital Technology, written by Mr Butler (not CCEA).

Your progress stays in this browser: back it up in My progress. Visits are counted anonymously, with no cookies.

Your name, form class and PIN save your progress online, so it follows you to any device. Mr Butler sees your name, form class, time spent revising (per page), pages covered, chapter-quiz scores and trophies, and nothing else.

How to use this app · Teacher area

Where to upload topic PowerPoints

Put a PowerPoint (or PDF) with any file name in the topic’s folder in the GitHub repo. Too big for GitHub (over 25 MB)? Put a OneDrive, SharePoint or Google Drive share link in a link.txt file in the folder instead. It appears on this page and in the workbook a minute or two later.
